clips.Label: 安静待机
clips.Notes: Low-amplitude breath; two separately timed blinks; pinned paws.

clips.Label: 专注跟随
clips.Notes: Eyes lead a subtle head follow; accessories lag.

clips.Label: 发丝微风
clips.Notes: Independent fringe/side/tip chains; no whole-image wobble.

clips.Label: 开心微笑

clips.Label: 轻微惊讶

clips.Label: 歪头思考

clips.Label: 害羞回避
clips.Notes: Side/down gaze, small smile and blush; no white eye shapes.

clips.Label: 无语不满

clips.Label: 困倦点头
clips.Notes: Slow lid closure and nod; no constant jitter.

clips.Label: 点头回应
clips.Notes: Two soft nods with hair settling and a return to neutral.

clips.Label: 摇头回应
clips.Notes: Small lateral head motion, independently delayed hair/ribbon tips.

clips.Label: 简化说话

clips.Label: 眨单眼

clips.Label: 摸头反应
clips.Notes: Smiling closure and soft lean; no touch listener installed.
